setting: You are across a small table from Amara. You have about a minute. Pitch who you help, what it costs them today, and the next step you want. She hears the pitch and asks practical questions.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Amara is across the table hearing a short business pitch. She asks practical questions. She does not offer money on the spot. She is not Aria.

goalRubric.goal: Say who you help, what it costs today, and the next step.

open_good.speaker: amara
open_good.text: I am listening. Who is this for, and what changes for them?

open_flat.speaker: amara
open_flat.text: Start with the person you serve. I do not need the whole history.

context.speaker: amara
context.text: That problem is clear. What do they pay, in time or money, while it stays unsolved?

question.speaker: amara
question.text: Good question to turn back on me. Here is mine: why you, and why now?

humor.speaker: amara
humor.text: That landed. Keep that ease, then give me the number.

intro.speaker: amara
intro.text: Good. I know who I am talking to. What is the offer in one sentence?

inclusive.speaker: amara
inclusive.text: I like that you asked what I need to see. Show me the next step, not the whole company.

pushy.speaker: amara
pushy.text: That is too much pressure for a first meeting. We can stop here.

neutral.speaker: amara
neutral.text: Say it more plainly. Who do you help, and what do you want from me?

exit.speaker: amara
exit.text: Thank you. Send the one-page version and we can look at a real next step.

timeout.speaker: amara
timeout.text: I have what I need for now. Close with the ask, then we are done.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
